support.title: Help centre
support.subtitle: Quick guides and frequent questions for running a car rental shop on XePrime.

vehicles.title: Add a vehicle
vehicles.body: Fill in the details, photos and documents so the vehicle is ready for the marketplace.

policies.title: Set rental policies
policies.body: Deposit, handover, late fees and discounts shared across the whole shop.

requests.title: Review rental requests
requests.body: Customer requests wait for your confirmation before they become bookings.

calendar.title: Read the rental calendar
calendar.body: Every vehicle and every occupied period on a single grid.

finance.title: Record receipts and payments
finance.body: The shop's cash book and outstanding debts live under Finance.

members.title: Invite your staff
members.body: Add users and grant permissions by role inside the shop.

publish.q: Why is my vehicle not on the marketplace yet?
publish.a: A vehicle only goes live after the platform approves both the shop and the vehicle. While you wait you can still manage vehicles and take bookings.

requestVsBooking.q: How is a rental request different from a booking?
requestVsBooking.a: A rental request is a customer proposal and does not hold the vehicle. Once you approve it, it becomes a booking and locks that period.

conflict.q: Why can't two bookings overlap on the same vehicle?
conflict.a: Overlap is blocked in the database itself, so one vehicle can never hold two overlapping rentals. Change the period or pick another vehicle.

longTerm.q: How is the return date calculated for long-term rentals?
longTerm.a: Long-term packages run on calendar months: the return date is the pickup date plus the package length, computed by the system rather than by multiplying 30 days.

maintenance.a: Under Operations, inside My vehicles: 'Maintenance' tracks the whole fleet, while a single vehicle's history sits in that vehicle's profile.

missingMenu.q: Why can't I see a menu item?
missingMenu.a: The menu follows your account's permissions. If an item you need is missing, ask the shop owner to grant it under Users & permissions.

contact.title: Still stuck?
contact.body: Reach out to your shop owner or administrator for access and further guidance.
